items.source: This implementation creates a UrlResource, delegating to createRelativeURL(String) for adapting the relative path.

items.source: protocol - the URL protocol to use (for example, "jar" or "file" - without colon); also known as "scheme"
items.translation: protocol - 要使用的 URL 协议（例如，"jar"或"file" - 不含冒号）；也称为“方案”

items.translation: location - 位置（例如该协议内的文件路径）； 也称为“特定于方案的组成部分”

items.source: This factory method is a convenience for UrlResource(URI) that catches any MalformedURLException and rethrows it wrapped in an UncheckedIOException; suitable for use in Stream and Optional APIs or other scenarios when a checked IOException is undesirable.
items.translation: 此工厂方法是 `UrlResource(URI)` 的便捷方法，它会捕获任何 MalformedURLException 并将其包装在 UncheckedIOException 中重新抛出；适用于 Stream 和 Optional API，或其他不希望出现已检查的 IOException 的场景。

items.source: This factory method is a convenience for UrlResource(String) that catches any MalformedURLException and rethrows it wrapped in an UncheckedIOException; suitable for use in Stream and Optional APIs or other scenarios when a checked IOException is undesirable.
items.translation: 此工厂方法是为 `UrlResource(String)` 提供的便利方法，它会捕获任何 `MalformedURLException 并将其包装在 `UncheckedIOException` 中重新抛出；适用于 `Stream` 和 `Optional API，或其他不希望出现已检查的 `IOException` 的场景。

items.source: Calls ResourceUtils.useCachesIfNecessary(URLConnection) and delegates to AbstractFileResolvingResource.customizeConnection(HttpURLConnection) if possible. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 调用ResourceUtils.useCachesIfNecessary(URLConnection)，并在可能的情况下委托给AbstractFileResolvingResource.customizeConnection(HttpURLConnection)。可在子类中重写此方法。

items.source: By default, caching will be applied only to jar resources. An explicit true flag applies caching to all resources, whereas an explicit false flag turns off caching for jar resources as well.
items.translation: 默认情况下，缓存仅应用于 jar 资源。显式设置 `true` 标志会对所有资源启用缓存，而显式设置 `false` 标志则会同时关闭 jar 资源的缓存。

items.source: Note: The given path needs to be pre-encoded if necessary.
items.translation: 注意：如果必要，需要预先对给定路径进行编码。

items.source: The given parts will automatically get encoded if necessary.
items.translation: 给定的部分在必要时将自动进行编码。

items.source:
A leading slash will get dropped; a "#" symbol will get encoded.
Note that this method effectively cleans the combined path as of 6.1.
items.translation: 前导斜杠将被丢弃；"#"符号将被编码。请注意，此方法自 6.1 版本起会有效地清理组合路径。

items.source: Resource implementation for java.net.URL locators. Supports resolution as a URL and also as a File in case of the "file:" protocol.
items.translation: Resource 实现，用于定位 java.net.URL。支持解析为 URL，并且在 "file:" 协议的情况下也支持解析为 File。
